claim_verdicts.evidence: Definitional: the lesson's own definition of technical-debt, principal and interest, copied from outline items 1-2. No docs root in content/versions.yaml governs this concept; nothing version-dependent.

Round 2: `tools/extract-code deploy/gitops/config-repo/envs/{staging,production}/api.yaml --tag stage-3` (full files, 83 lines each). Line 1: `# The api in staging, ...` vs `# The api in production, ...`; line 20: `replicas: 2` vs `replicas: 3`. Every other line, incl. line 42 `image: ghcr.io/duyan11110/donhang-api:sha-bb184243...`, lines 54-71 and the Service (73-83), is identical.

stage-3 (tools/extract-code): line 18 `# What differs between envs/staging and envs/production: the number of`, line 19 `# replicas here and the image tag below.`; line 42 image identical in both files; line 71 `memory: 512Mi`; lines 40-41 note 'A deploy is a commit that changes this tag', consistent with the tag differing only between a staging deploy and the next promotion.

Both envs/staging and envs/production hold the same nine manifests (api.yaml, api-configmap.yaml, db.yaml, db-init.yaml, keycloak.yaml, keycloak-realm.yaml, mailpit.yaml, migrate-hook.yaml, redis.yaml) and each api.yaml carries the full Deployment incl. probes (57-64) and resources (65-71); no kustomization.yaml in config-repo, so nothing is shared between the folders. A shared edit must be made in each file.

config-repo-kustomize/envs/production/kustomization.yaml: `resources: - ../../base`, patch only `/spec/replicas` value 3, plus `images:`; `livenessProbe` and `memory: 512Mi` occur only in config-repo-kustomize/base/api.yaml (lines 62, 76), so a probe or memory change is made once in the base. Matches k8s.l2.config-repo-overlays outline 4. (Read on the working tree in round 1; section 4 change in round 2 does not touch this claim.)

Follows directly from the lesson's definition (interest is paid per change, principal pays back only through later changes); no official doc root in versions.yaml covers it. Stated with conditions in section 4 and, after round 1, in section 6 ('almost no interest of this kind').

Conditional judgement ('can be sound', 'when delivering sooner is worth more', 'provided the team knows'), worded as in outline item 5; the round-2 sentence 'A team that cannot name the interest cannot weigh it against the principal' is reasoning from the lesson's own definitions, not a fact about any tool or version.

First half is shown by the lesson's own example (claims 2, 4). Second half now carries the condition 'almost no interest of this kind, because no change has to work around it', which follows from the definition of interest; no longer stated as a general fact.
Follows from the definition ('how its code or setup is shaped'); the manifest case is the lesson's own example (claims 2, 4). The unsupported table-layout clause was removed in round 1.

git-scm git-diff: 'git diff [<options>] --no-index [--] <path> <path>' — 'This form is to compare the given two paths on the filesystem.' Unified format: '`-` (minus — appears in A but removed in B), `+` (plus — missing in A but added to B)'. Stage-3 files differ only at lines 1 and 20 (claim 2), 19 lines apart, so with default context they fall in separate hunks. Command not executed (permission denied).
